proposed_claims.proof_obligation: Construct each algebra form, distinguish specialization from quotient, state q order/parity/divisibility and prove the comparison maps.

proposed_claims.claim: State quantum Frobenius and tilting-module structure only in the declared Cartan/root-order regime.
